capabilities: Triage inbox notes one at a time with archive, move, promote, link and undo actions
Save rule-based smart folder searches in the sidebar
Find broken links, unused attachments and iCloud duplicate copies with one-click fixes
Create literature notes with metadata, abstract and BibTeX from arXiv and DOI links
Read and search text in screenshots and scanned images on macOS
extras: Free with no accounts, payments, ads or telemetry; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; part of the Tahoe plugin family; text-from-images needs a Mac (Xcode command line tools or AppleScript).
problem: A growing Obsidian vault lacks built-in tools for triaging new notes, finding broken links and unused attachments, and resolving iCloud's duplicate file copies.

relations.evidence: With Tahoe Intelligence: inbox triage suggests a folder, tags and a better title for each note
With Tahoe: the tool pages take the theme's settings-style cards and grouped rows

summary: Vault tidying toolkit with inbox triage, smart folders, colored tags, link suggestions, vault health checks, iCloud conflict fixes, literature notes and image OCR.
